title.en: Unclamped pre-overdraw stock–flow embedding, finite-horizon trap, and coupled indexed correspondence

statement.en: Before overdraw (and globally on unending courses), LineOnAStock and WayUnderARule trajectories embed verbatim without clamping into Flow.BalancesOn, transferring finite-horizon drawdown trapping (Flow.never_returns_below_within) and matching Coupled.Indexed.step on constant-draw runs.

laws.en: Finite-horizon drawdown trap and unclamped Flow embedding: Flow.never_returns_below_within generalizes Continuation's infinite-tail trap to finite pre-overdraw intervals [T, T + N) given initial below : W.level T c < m, [T, T + N) BalancesOn, and sub-threshold given ≤ taken. WayUnderARule.taken_below / unending_taken_below supply strict taken < x on goes ≤ T + N (respectively globally).

Pre-overdraw LineOnAStock and WayUnderARule bridges: line_balancesOn_of_goes, way_balancesOn_of_goes (and global balances on unending courses) embed both trajectories without clamping into Web Unit Unit and Flow Unit Unit, deriving conservation equations (line_account_of_goes, line_account_unending_via_flow, way_account_of_goes, way_account_unending) and drawdown traps (line_never_returns_below_within, way_never_returns_below_within).

Constant-draw Coupled.Indexed correspondence: on ι := Unit (Drawn.whole), whenever all needs are met (< k) and active rules keep total draw constant at H₀, LineOnAStock.left and WayUnderARule levels coincide verbatim with Law.orbit (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.step Drawn.whole G H) (fun _ => x₀) k () (line_coupled_indexed_correspondence, way_coupled_indexed_correspondence, way_coupled_indexed_of_unfavoured).

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Pre-overdraw Flow balances hold only up to T + N (requires Goes ≤ T + N, FromNothing giving, Needing); Flow.never_returns_below_within requires initial below : W.level T c < m; Coupled.Indexed correspondence requires all needs met and constant draw across rules.

does_not_show.en: Overdrawing steps where x < taken (Nat subtraction truncates, so Flow conservation breaks at failure rather than being salvaged by min-clamping).
Absorption of LineOnAStock.way_ends / WayUnderARule.tested_or_ends by Flow.family_excess_ends or Stage 2 deletion of ends_all.
